m5: Provide required, optional, prohibited and conditional decisions.
Provide compatibility information for document type and jurisdiction.
Provide source metadata and clause version information.
Provide insertion_key for each clause when placement is required.
m1: Accept only approved clauses for assembly.
Validate clause insertion_key against the selected template.
Preserve clause source metadata and version information.
Do not modify or invent approved legal clause text.

rules: Only clauses with approval_status=approved may be assembled.
Document type and jurisdiction must be compatible with the selected template.
Prohibited or incompatible clauses must not be selected.
Each clause requiring placement must provide a valid insertion_key.
The insertion_key must exist in the selected template section_placeholders.
Clause version and source metadata must be preserved for provenance.
M1 must not create new legal clause text.
notes: M5 owns approved clause content and legal compatibility decisions.
M1 owns deterministic template selection, validation, placement and assembly.
M1 does not reinterpret or rewrite M5 legal decisions.
M1 passes provenance information downstream through the GenerationManifest.
